headline: 本周影剧：人性本兽领跑，七净土首播
summary: 电影方面，本周《人性本兽》《另一个妈咪》等热作上映，待映片单有《沙丘3》《复仇者联盟5》；剧集方面，《降世神通：七净土》《幻视任务》首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》等热播。

industryHighlights.text: 本周电影热作包括《人性本兽》《另一个妈咪》《致命录像带：混音带》等。
industryHighlights.en: This week's film highlights include Human Nature, Another Mommy, and V/H/S: Mixtape.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《降世神通：七净土》《幻视任务》本周首播。
industryHighlights.en: New series Avatar: Seven Havens and Vision Quest premiere this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《侠探杰克》《魔女嘉莉》《绿灯军团》《菜鸟老警》等剧持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: Reacher, Carrie, Lanterns, and The Rookie remain in hot rotation.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影有《猫鼬》《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《泥面人》《哥斯拉-0.0》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Mongoose, Avengers 5, Dune 3, Clayface, and Godzilla-0.0.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Human Nature Leads, Seven Havens Premieres
summaryEn: In film, this week's hot releases include Human Nature and Another Mommy, while Dune 3 and Avengers 5 lead upcoming titles. On TV, Avatar: Seven Havens and Vision Quest premiere, with Reacher and Lanterns still hot.
